definitions.gloss: going to Tokyo, visiting the capital
definitions.explanation: Traveling to Tokyo, especially from rural areas or other regions of Japan.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}{進学|しんがく}のために{上京|じょうきょう}した。
examples.english: I went to Tokyo to attend university.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}で{月|つき}に{一度|いちど}{上京|じょうきょう}する。
examples.english: I go to Tokyo once a month for work.

examples.japanese: {田舎|いなか}から{上京|じょうきょう}して{十年|じゅうねん}になる。
examples.english: It's been ten years since I came to Tokyo from the countryside.

notes:
{上京|じょうきょう}する is used as a する-verb meaning "to go up to Tokyo."

HISTORICAL NOTE:
The term {上京|じょうきょう} literally means "going up to the capital." Historically, this referred to Kyoto ({京都|きょうと}). After the Meiji Restoration (1868), when the capital moved to Tokyo, {上京|じょうきょう} came to mean going to Tokyo.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上京|じょうきょう}する (to go to Tokyo)
- {上京|じょうきょう}{組|ぐみ} (people who moved to Tokyo)

RELATED WORDS:
- {帰京|ききょう}: returning to Tokyo
- {在京|ざいきょう}: being in Tokyo
- {入京|にゅうきょう}: entering the capital (literary)
